notes.title: Air Raid Over Britain - Overhaul & Revamp
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who has downloaded and experienced Air Raid Over Britain during our early preview builds. In the latest patch, we've completely overhauled the core functionality of Air Raid Over Britain. It now includes more interaction and gameplay mechanics, as well as a completely new "look-at" mechanic to uncover facts about history of "The Blitz" (1940-1941) and other various aspects of WWII. We've still included the ability to experience a HE-111 air raid during both the day and at night, but now you control when the event happens. 

We appreciate your feedback and suggestions on how we can improve this experience in future builds.

notes.title: Revamping & User Feedback
notes.content: Thanks to everyone who's played our early access, technical demo and left constructive feedback. Over the past few months we've been coalescing the feedback we've received from the community as well as in-person, live demos. Based on this feedback, we are revamping the entire experience from the ground up. Again, we appreciate everyone who's left constructive feedback as we continue to refine and build this into a unique and interesting experience.
